question: Which of the following statements best describes the properties of a liquid?

options.text: No fixed shape, no fixed volume

solution:
The correct answer is __**No fixed shape, fixed volume**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Matter** in the **liquid state** is characterized by its ability to **flow** and change **shape**, but it maintains a **constant volume** under consistent **temperature** and **pressure**.
 
• A liquid has **no fixed shape** because the **kinetic energy** of its particles is high enough to overcome the **rigid bonds** seen in solids. This allows particles to slide past one another, meaning the liquid takes the shape of whatever **container** it occupies.
 
• Liquids possess a **fixed volume** because the **intermolecular forces of attraction** are still strong enough to keep the particles close together. Unlike **gases**, the particles in a liquid do not have enough energy to completely escape the attraction of their neighbors.
 
• Because the particles are packed closely, liquids have **very low compressibility**. This means that even under high **pressure**, the **volume** of a liquid remains virtually **unchanged**.
